title: Laboratory Tech - Full Time - Days - Trinity Health Livonia

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory Tech to join our team in the Specimen Processing Department.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Performs successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients to include venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection utilizing proper patient identification and customer service skills. Troubleshoots problems related to missing specimens, discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Obtains patient demographic and insurance information from a patient or patient advocate. Performs data entry through the electronic medical record system which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notice (ABN) and utilize automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Acts as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Responds to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Uses good judgment to decide when to contact a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or a Pathologist, as necessary.
Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discusses patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private places. Adheres to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
Interpersonal skills necessary to effectively communicate with patients and other health care professionals
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities
Familiarity and comfort with using computers
Preferred Requirements
Previous phlebotomy experience or related experience
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant or patient care technician training
Previous medical/lab experience
Organizational skills necessary to prioritize work. Flexibility to accommodate task and location reassignment as needed

Performs phlebotomy on both outpatient and inpatients. Performs specimen processing, computer order entry and other pre-analytic functions, as required. Obtains accurate patient demographic and financial information from patients or patient advocate. May register outpatients in the hospital electronic medical record system ([Product name masked]) and determines preliminary patient or insurance payment obligation.
cond_0066.responsibilities:
Performs successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients to include venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection utilizing proper patient identification and customer service skills. Troubleshoots problems related to missing specimens, discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Obtains patient demographic and insurance information from a patient or patient advocate. Performs data entry through the electronic medical record system which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notice (ABN) and utilize automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Acts as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Responds to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Uses good judgment to decide when to contact a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or a Pathologist, as necessary.
Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discusses patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private places. Adheres to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0066.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant, or patient care technician training is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Willingness to communicate effectively with patients and other health care professionals.
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities.
Organizational skills to help prioritize work, with openness to task and location reassignment as needed.

Performs phlebotomy on both outpatient and inpatients. Performs specimen processing, computer order entry and other pre-analytic functions, as required. Obtains accurate patient demographic and financial information from patients or patient advocate. May register outpatients in the hospital electronic medical record system ([Product name masked]) and determines preliminary patient or insurance payment obligation.
cond_0102.responsibilities:
Performs successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients to include venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection utilizing proper patient identification and customer service skills. Troubleshoots problems related to missing specimens, discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Obtains patient demographic and insurance information from a patient or patient advocate. Performs data entry through the electronic medical record system which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notice (ABN) and utilize automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Acts as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Responds to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Uses good judgment to decide when to contact a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or a Pathologist, as necessary.
Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discusses patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private places. Adheres to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0102.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant, or patient care technician training is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
Some medical or lab background is preferred, but not required to be considered.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Willingness to communicate effectively with patients and other health care professionals.
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities.
Organizational skills to help prioritize work, with openness to task and location reassignment as needed.
Basic comfort with using computers.
cond_0102.encouragement_text: Some phlebotomy or related experience is preferred, though candidates with relevant training or coursework are encouraged to apply.
cond_0102.values: We value contributing in ways that are helpful, responsible, and considerate of others. We believe the quality of our work includes how well it serves people and how fairly it is carried out.
cond_0102.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, and inclusive benefits. We want employees from different backgrounds to feel supported and able to thrive.

cond_0180.intro:
We are looking for a Laboratory Tech to join our team in the Specimen Processing Department.
This role works alongside patients and healthcare professionals to support specimen collection, processing, and pre-analytic functions. You will help coordinate accurate patient demographic and financial information and assist with registration in the hospital electronic medical record system ([Product name masked]) to help determine preliminary patient or insurance payment obligations.
cond_0180.responsibilities:
Coordinate successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients, including venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection, using proper patient identification and customer service skills. Work with colleagues to troubleshoot problems related to missing specimens and discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Gather patient demographic and insurance information from patients or patient advocates. Support data entry through the electronic medical record system, which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notices (ABN), and using automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Serve as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Respond to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Use good judgment to decide when to involve a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or Pathologist, as necessary.
Maintain knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to assist other healthcare professionals. Access online resources for assistance when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Work with minimal supervision and may be asked to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Coordinate specimen handling and processing, including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquot and adjust pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Help maintain minimum supply levels and cleanliness of the workstation and section. Contribute input on policies and procedures. Assist in training new employees and students.
Review and complete assigned continuing education documents, including annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Perform and document routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintain cooperative working relationships. Approach conflict constructively. Help identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintain the confidentiality of information pertaining to patients, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discuss patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private settings. Adhere to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Take responsibility for performing job duties as safely as possible, to protect personal safety and that of coworkers, and report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0180.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Previous phlebotomy experience preferred or related experience.
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant or patient care technician training preferred.
Previous medical/lab experience preferred.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Interpersonal skills necessary to effectively communicate with patients and other healthcare professionals.
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities.
Organizational skills necessary to prioritize work. Flexibility to accommodate task and location reassignment as needed.
Familiarity and comfort with using computers.

Performs successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients to include venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection utilizing proper patient identification and customer service skills. Troubleshoots problems related to missing specimens, discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Obtains patient demographic and insurance information from a patient or patient advocate. Performs data entry through the electronic medical record system which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notice (ABN) and utilize automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Acts as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Responds to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Uses good judgment to decide when to contact a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or a Pathologist, as necessary.
Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discusses patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private places. Adheres to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0199.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
Interpersonal skills necessary to effectively communicate with patients and other health care professionals
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities
Familiarity and comfort with using computers
Preferred Requirements
Previous phlebotomy experience or related experience
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant or patient care technician training
Previous medical/lab experience
Organizational skills necessary to prioritize work. Flexibility to accommodate task and location reassignment as needed
cond_0199.values: We value contributing in ways that are helpful, responsible, and considerate of others. We believe the quality of our work includes how well it serves people and how fairly it is carried out.

This role works alongside patients and healthcare professionals to support specimen collection, processing, and pre-analytic functions. You will help coordinate accurate patient demographic and financial information and assist with registration in the hospital electronic medical record system ([Product name masked]) to help determine preliminary patient or insurance payment obligations.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Coordinate successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients, including venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection, using proper patient identification and customer service skills. Work with colleagues to troubleshoot problems related to missing specimens and discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Gather patient demographic and insurance information from patients or patient advocates. Support data entry through the electronic medical record system, which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notices (ABN), and using automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Serve as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Respond to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Use good judgment to decide when to involve a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or Pathologist, as necessary.
Maintain knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to assist other healthcare professionals. Access online resources for assistance when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Work with minimal supervision and may be asked to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Coordinate specimen handling and processing, including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquot and adjust pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Help maintain minimum supply levels and cleanliness of the workstation and section. Contribute input on policies and procedures. Assist in training new employees and students.
Review and complete assigned continuing education documents, including annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Perform and document routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintain cooperative working relationships. Approach conflict constructively. Help identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintain the confidentiality of information pertaining to patients, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discuss patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private settings. Adhere to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Take responsibility for performing job duties as safely as possible, to protect personal safety and that of coworkers, and report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0252.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Previous phlebotomy experience preferred or related experience.
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant or patient care technician training preferred.
Previous medical/lab experience preferred.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Interpersonal skills necessary to effectively communicate with patients and other healthcare professionals.
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities.
Organizational skills necessary to prioritize work. Flexibility to accommodate task and location reassignment as needed.
Familiarity and comfort with using computers.
cond_0252.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

cond_0302.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory Tech to join our team in the Specimen Processing Department. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with phlebotomy and specimen processing work.
cond_0302.responsibilities:
Performs successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients to include venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection utilizing proper patient identification and customer service skills. Troubleshoots problems related to missing specimens, discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Obtains patient demographic and insurance information from a patient or patient advocate. Performs data entry through the electronic medical record system which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notice (ABN) and utilize automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Acts as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Responds to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Uses good judgment to decide when to contact a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or a Pathologist, as necessary.
Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discusses patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private places. Adheres to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0302.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Previous phlebotomy experience preferred or related experience.
Completion of phlebotomy, medical assistant or patient care technician training preferred.
Previous medical/lab experience preferred.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Interpersonal skills necessary to effectively communicate with patients and other health care professionals.
Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing job responsibilities.
Organizational skills necessary to prioritize work. Flexibility to accommodate task and location reassignment as needed.
Familiarity and comfort with using computers.

cond_0365.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory Tech to join our Specimen Processing Department. The role involves phlebotomy on both outpatient and inpatients, specimen processing, computer order entry, and other pre-analytic functions. You will obtain accurate patient demographic and financial information from patients or patient advocates, and may register outpatients in the hospital electronic medical record system and determine preliminary patient or insurance payment obligations. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with phlebotomy and specimen processing work.
cond_0365.responsibilities:
Performs successful sample collection on outpatient and inpatients to include venipuncture blood draw, capillary puncture, infant heel sticks, and urine collection utilizing proper patient identification and customer service skills. Troubleshoots problems related to missing specimens, discrepancies between specimens and orders.
Obtains patient demographic and insurance information from a patient or patient advocate. Performs data entry through the electronic medical record system which may include insurance verification, issuing Advance Beneficiary Notice (ABN) and utilize automated systems to obtain and process insurance information.
Acts as a representative of the department, communicating with patients and physician offices. Responds to inquiries in a courteous and helpful manner following departmental policies and procedures.
Uses good judgment to decide when to contact a Medical Laboratory Scientist, Manager, or a Pathologist, as necessary.
Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Discusses patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel in appropriately private places. Adheres to all hospital HIPAA and privacy policies.
Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
Performs other duties as assigned.

cond_0498.intro:

Performs phlebotomy on both outpatient and inpatients. Performs specimen processing, computer order entry and other pre-analytic functions, as required. May register outpatients in the hospital electronic medical record system ([Product name masked]) and determines preliminary patient or insurance payment obligation.

Knowledge of reference sources for patient preparation and specimen collection and handling requirements to be able to assist other health care professionals. Able to access on-line websites for assistance, when needed.
May utilize a glucometer or perform waived urine testing prior to administration of glucola.
Must be able to work with minimal supervision. May be requested to travel to other phlebotomy service centers (PSC).
Completes specimen handling and processing including centrifugation of vacutainer and aliquoting/pouring over of specimens. Aliquots and adjusts pH of 24-hour urine specimens as required by location.
Maintains minimum supply levels and maintains cleanliness of workstation and of the section. Provides input on policies and procedures. Assists in training new employees and students.
Reviews and completes assigned continuing education documents. This includes annual mandatory education and laboratory procedures review and acknowledgment.
Performs and documents routine quality control of equipment (centrifuge, refrigerator temperatures) as required by location.
Maintains good rapport and cooperative relationships. Approaches conflict in a constructive manner. Helps to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
Maintains the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patient, physicians, associates, and visitors to [Company name masked]. Assumes responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, and to report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices immediately to management.
